criteria.rationale: Born September 17, 1969, the patient was 56 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note describes Wegovy for excess weight after a lifestyle-program plateau.
The August 19 note documents continued adherence to the previously specified reduced-calorie diet and walking plan, and directs the patient to continue both with Wegovy.

The documented program began December 19, 2025, and continued through August 19, 2026—eight whole calendar months. The notes document reduced-calorie diet, physical activity, and continuing coaching and follow-up, with no documented interruption.
The latest structured pre-request BMI is 29.2, meeting the ≥27 threshold, and an active hypertension diagnosis supplies a documented weight-related comorbidity.

parsed.summary: All five modeled criteria are met. The patient is 56, Wegovy is requested for chronic weight management with continued diet and activity, the documented program spans eight months, and BMI 29.2 qualifies with diagnosed hypertension.
